title: The Latest Crier for Apr 16, 2026
items:
Benefit Bash this Saturday!

Get ready for an unforgettable night at Benefit Bash this Saturday, April 18, from 7–10 p.m. at the Pella Opera House! 

If you haven’t grabbed your ticket yet, there’s still time—stop by the Student Development Office to purchase yours for just $10. 

This year’s event features a masquerade theme, and masks will be provided—just bring your energy and enjoy the mystery! Snacks will be available, along with a cash bar for guests 21+. 

Don’t miss out—we can’t wait to see you there!
